name: mcp-server-matrix
description: MCP server for Matrix messaging and room management
long_description: Interact with Matrix homeservers over stdio MCP. Read, search and send messages, list and search rooms, follow unread conversations and mark them read, react to messages, and inspect room details and members.

matrixHomeserver.title: Homeserver URL
matrixHomeserver.description: Matrix homeserver URL, for example https://matrix.org.

matrixUser.title: Matrix user ID
matrixUser.description: Full Matrix user ID, for example @bot:example.com.

matrixPassword.title: Password
matrixPassword.description: Account password. Provide this or an access token. The session is saved and reused, so restarts do not create new devices.

matrixAccessToken.title: Access token
matrixAccessToken.description: Account access token. Provide this or a password.

matrixDeviceId.title: Device ID
matrixDeviceId.description: Optional device ID that belongs to the access token.

matrixDeviceName.title: Device name
matrixDeviceName.description: Device name shown in your Matrix sessions after a password login.

matrixStorePath.title: Store path
matrixStorePath.description: Optional folder for the nio store and the saved session. Leave empty to use ~/.mcp-server-matrix/nio_store.

matrixTimezone.title: Time zone
matrixTimezone.description: IANA time zone for message times and for dates given without offset, for example Europe/Madrid. Leave empty for UTC.

mcpLogLevel.title: Log level
mcpLogLevel.description: Process log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a Matrix room.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read messages from a Matrix room in chronological order.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search for messages containing a keyword or phrase in a room's history.

tools.name: search_rooms
tools.description: Search joined Matrix rooms by name, alias, or topic.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List Matrix rooms the user has joined, alphabetically.

tools.name: get_room_info
tools.description: Get details about a Matrix room: name, topic, member count, alias.

tools.name: get_room_members
tools.description: List the members of a Matrix room.

tools.name: send_reaction
tools.description: Send an emoji reaction to a specific message in a Matrix room.

tools.name: list_unread_rooms
tools.description: List rooms with unread messages for the user, with unread and mention counts.

tools.name: read_unread_messages
tools.description: Read the user's unread Matrix messages, grouped by room, oldest first, as plain text suitable for reading aloud.

tools.name: mark_room_read
tools.description: Mark everything in a Matrix room as read for the user (moves the read marker and read receipt to the latest message).
